content.comment_body: I've noticed there's a free Excel add-in app ([product_name] Access Tool). It took quite a while to locate the download online, and I only have the original CD for the [product_name] software without the updated service pack. The issue is that the add-in tab for Excel is missing from Office 365, with no clear method to restore it (many others have reported this online). Microsoft doesn't have a solution either. Is there an alternative way to achieve this? Thanks

There is no recent update from [company_name]. The Access Tool has only been tested and officially released for specific Excel versions and [product_name] modules: ● Office Excel 2007, 2010, 2013 (32-bit and 64-bit) ● [product_name] standard modules, versions FS4 and above. However, I recall that the tool might need to be enabled somewhere within newer Excel versions. I’ll try to locate the relevant forum posts again.
I discovered this information in another thread.

Thank you for the suggestions. Unfortunately, nothing resolved the issue. I managed to use the version on my CD and that worked properly. This whole situation could have been avoided if [company_name] simply made it available for download. It's unfortunate that the tool cannot write values to the controller.

We apologize that the [product_name] Access Tool isn't currently available. If you require it, you can initiate a "Support Request" and our technical support team can provide the software for you. Thank you for your understanding.
[product_name] Access Tool is available for download here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter significant challenges finding and installing the [product_name] Access Tool for connecting modules to Excel, especially with newer Office 365 versions where the Excel add-in tab goes missing. Compatibility constraints and limited download options for the tool cause frustration. Users also express disappointment that the tool is read-only and cannot send data to the controller.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want simple access and installation of the [product_name] Access Tool for use with the latest Excel versions, and expect it to support both reading and writing data between Excel and the controller.
